name: Craig Green

prices.note: Trousers collection (GBP, no US storefront path), 2 available regular-price: Utility Trouser £450, Worker Trouser £475, both lightweight elasticated wool with an engineered cord belt.

notes: Ships from the UK to the UK, selected European destinations, North America and selected international destinations; North America £35, free on orders of £500 and above; international orders ship DDP, so no duties on delivery; North America 3-7 business days (https://www.craig-green.com/policies/shipping-policy).

About: founded in London in 2012; menswear language rooted in uniform, utility and workwear (https://www.craig-green.com/pages/about).
